snippet.title: Ace Banana - Launch Trailer | PS VR
snippet.description:
Mischievous monkeys are on the loose and have an eye on your innocent bananas… Show off your master Banana Archer skills and protect your stash with an arsenal of arrows including plungers, rubber fish and even panda bears because once all your bananas are stolen, it’s game over! Keep up to date on all the monkey business and like “Ace Banana” on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Ace-Banana-988477561265716/
